beats.text: Six signs you're quietly outgrowing your old life.
One. Old conversations feel small now. You're hungry for something with more depth.
Two. You crave meaning over comfort. The safe option has stopped feeling like enough.
Three. You've become far pickier about who gets access to your time and energy.
Four. Things that used to impress you now feel a little hollow.
Five. You'd genuinely rather be alone than badly accompanied.
Six. You feel slightly out of place where you once fit perfectly. You've changed; the room hasn't.
Outgrowing a life isn't betrayal. It's the quiet, uncomfortable proof that you're growing.
